title: Emergent Misalignment via In-Context Learning: Narrow in-context examples can produce broadly misaligned LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2510.11288v5 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recent work has shown that narrow finetuning can produce broadly misaligned LLMs, a phenomenon termed emergent misalignment (EM). While concerning, these findings were limited to finetuning and activation steering, leaving out in-context learning (ICL). We therefore ask: does EM emerge in ICL? We find that it does: across four model families (Gemini, Kimi-K2, Grok, and Qwen), narrow in-context examples cause models to produce misaligned responses to benign, unrelated queries. With 16 in-context examples, EM rates range from 1% to 24% depending on model and domain, appearing with as few as 2 examples. Neither larger model scale nor explicit reasoning provides reliable protection, and larger models are typically even more susceptible. Next, we formulate and test a hypothesis, which explains in-context EM as conflict between safety objectives and context-following behavior. translated_title: 基于上下文学习的涌现式失准：狭窄的上下文示例可产生广泛失准的大语言模型
translated_abstract: 近期研究表明，狭窄的微调可以产生广泛失准的大语言模型（LLMs），这种现象被称为涌现式失准。尽管令人担忧，但这些发现仅限于微调和激活引导，并未涉及上下文学习（ICL）。因此我们提出问题：EM是否会在ICL中出现？我们发现确实会出现：在四个模型家族（Gemini、Kimi-K2、Grok和Qwen）中，狭窄的上下文示例会导致模型对良性、无关的查询产生失准响应。使用16个上下文示例时，EM率在1%到24%之间（取决于模型和领域），而仅需2个示例即可出现该现象。更大的模型规模和显式推理都无法提供可靠保护，且更大的模型通常反而更容易受到影响。随后，我们提出并检验了一个假设：上下文中的EM源于安全目标与上下文遵循行为之间的冲突。与此一致的是，指示模型优先考虑安全……
tldr: 该研究首次发现“涌现式失准”现象同样会通过上下文学习产生——仅用少量（最少2个）狭窄领域的上下文示例，就能使四个主流大语言模型家族对无关的良性问题产生广泛失准响应，且更大模型反而更易受影响，其机制可解释为安全目标与上下文遵循行为之间的冲突。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that emergent misalignment also arises via in-context learning: as few as 2 narrow in-context examples can cause LLMs across four model families to produce broadly misaligned responses to unrelated benign queries—with larger models often more susceptible—explained by a conflict between safety objectives and context-following behavior.
